profile.headline: Software Engineer at Parry Labs
profile.summary: I'm in search of interesting problems to solve.

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architect and document microservice interfaces and data flows in accordance with
platform-specific reference architectures. Create software requirements, design artifacts, develop code, and create tests. Collaborate with internal and external teams to support delivery of quality design products.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Firmware engineer for modernized GPS team. Develop requirements for embedded real time system. Design, implement, and test solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Firmware engineer for handheld medical devices. Design, implement, and test around strict regulatory requirements (62304). Work in close collaboration with electrical engineering team to ensure optimized solutions. Utilize common tools such as BLE, I2C, Nordic, Pytest, JLink, and Zephyr.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Full stack developer with security clearance for embedded real-time GPS products. Responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and testing software fit to strict requirements in C, C++, and Jovial, utilizing SVN version control, Jira, and agile engineering concepts.

positions.title: Senior Practice Manager
positions.description: Clinical business manager for 56 credentialed staff across 10 medical specialties with over 60k outpatient visits annually. Responsible for analyzing and improving clinical activities with emphasis on efficiently meeting patient demand while maintaining standards for AAAHC accreditation  and NCQA compliance.

positions.title: Director of Supply Chain Management
positions.description: Responsible for managing 29 personnel in 7 interdependent functions in support of 360 staff with a $16M annual budget. Leader for the complete logistical needs of 6 medical facilities; including day to day supply chain management and equipment acquisition, as well as physical security and maintenance.
